verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe Mem0 Open Source as the same memory engine as the Platform running on your own infrastructure. It ships as a self-hosted Docker stack with the REST API, a dashboard, per-user API keys and an audit log, with a setup guide to stand it up in minutes. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of self-hosted deployment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Mem0 Open Source is the same memory engine as the Platform, running on your own infrastructure. You own the stack, the data, and every component
As a self-hosted server. A Docker stack with a dashboard, per-user API keys, and a request audit log.
Stand up the Mem0 REST server and dashboard in a few minutes, with an admin account, API keys, and a live audit log included.
Self-host Mem0 with full control over your infrastructure and data
